name: Question Formation — First Three Moves
description: 90 age-appropriate items for the first three Question Formation moves.
targetStudents: Chinese G12 EAL students; contexts are school-life, academic, debate, research, media, applications, clubs, and projects.

moves.eli5: Use this when the action already happened.
moves.exampleWrong: Why did the team changed the plan?
moves.exampleCorrect: Why did the team change the plan?
moves.chineseHint: 过去发生的动作，用 did + 动词原形。

moves.studentLabel: Ask what / where / how something is or was
moves.eli5: Use this when asking what something is, where something was, how something was, or why someone felt a certain way.
moves.quickRule: Put is / are / was / were before the subject.
moves.chineseHint: is / are / was / were 要放在主语前面。

moves.eli5: First decide whether the question asks what someone did, or describes how someone/something was.
moves.quickRule: Actions use did/do/does. Feelings, locations, identity, and descriptions use is/are/was/were.
moves.chineseHint: 如果问动作，用 do / does / did。如果描述感受、位置、身份或情况，用 is / are / was / were。
